answer: To enforce Sybil resistance, an economy of AI agents requires nodes to stake scarce asset collateral, such as tokenized reserves of timber or cedar, into smart contracts. By binding digital identities to verifiable physical resources, duplicate node creation requires proportional real-world capital. This renders the fable of costless virtual identities impossible; an attacker attempting to deploy a malicious agent swarm faces unsustainable, linear capital expenditure for every Sybil identity spawned.
